# OpenJLPT — Data Sources & Attribution

This application includes Kanji metadata derived from OpenJLPT:
https://github.com/evanclan/OpenJLPT

OpenJLPT's dataset is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0). The Kanji metadata used here is derived from the OpenJLPT Kanji data and is redistributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. This license applies to the derived dataset, not to unrelated application source code.

## Sources used for the Kanji metadata

| Source | Use | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| KANJIDIC2 — Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG) | Kanji readings, meanings, stroke counts, grade, frequency, radical and name-reading metadata | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| Jonathan Waller's JLPT Resources | Community N5–N2 level assignments | CC BY |

OpenJLPT source notice: https://github.com/evanclan/OpenJLPT/blob/main/NOTICE.md
EDRDG licence statement: https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html

Attribution:
"Contains Kanji data from OpenJLPT (CC BY-SA 4.0), using KANJIDIC2 (EDRDG) and Jonathan Waller's JLPT lists."

The JLPT has not published current official Kanji lists since 2010. The levels are community approximations and must not be represented as official JLPT classifications.

Any adapted or redistributed version of the OpenJLPT-derived Kanji metadata must retain the attribution and comply with the CC BY-SA 4.0 ShareAlike requirement.
